children: Calgary, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Olympia Financial Group Inc.
("Olympia") today announces its operating and financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Results from continuing operations for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, include the following (compared to operations for the nine months ended September 30, 2025):
Total net earnings and comprehensive income decreased 17% to $13.43 million from $16.13 million.
Total revenue decreased 9% to $64.16 million from $70.70 million.
Service revenue increased 2% to $34.04 million from $33.41 million mainly due to an increase in monthly and transaction fees.
Trust, interest, and other income decreased 19% to $30.12 million from $37.29 million mainly due to a decrease in interest rates on funds held in trust.
Other gains/(losses), net, increased more than 100% to $3.99 million from ($0.01) million mainly due to the sale of substantially all of the assets of the Raisr division.

Total expenses increased 2% to $50.10 million from $49.29 million primarily as a result of increased wages from the expansion of the strategy, governance, risk, and compliance departments. The increase can also be attributed to higher costs related to the new lease of the Calgary head office.
Earnings before income tax decreased 16% to $18.05 million from $21.40 million.
Basic and diluted earnings per share attributable to the shareholders of Olympia decreased 17% to $5.58 per share from $6.70 per share.

About Olympia Financial Group Inc.

Olympia conducts most of its operations through its subsidiary Olympia Trust Company, a non-deposit taking trust company. Olympia Trust Company is licensed to conduct trust activities in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Quebec, Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia. Olympia Trust Company administers self-directed registered plan accounts, corporate trust, and transfer agency services. Olympia also offers private health services plans through its subsidiary Olympia Benefits Inc.
Olympia's common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "OLY".
